notes_for_editor: Dates rest on one page (firelookout.com): 1936 L-4 cab and 1956 abandonment. The 1940 Geodetic Survey description (Forest Lookouts page) is the only independent sighting of the structure. The two sources use different reference points (Spotted Bear vs Big Prairie); not reconciled. The record's elevation is null; firelookout.com gives 8121 ft, which has no slot in facts. The Forest Lookouts page also carries a 'Removed' tag without a date, not used. No staffing, fire or access information found in the three pages read. Forest Service records were not checked.
